meta.name: planning-with-files-es
meta.description: Sistema de planificación basado en archivos estilo Manus para organizar y rastrear el progreso de tareas complejas. Crea task_plan.md, findings.md y progress.md. Cuando el usuario solicita planificación, desglose u organización de proyectos multipaso, tareas de investigación o trabajos que requieren más de 5 llamadas a herramientas. Soporta recuperación automática de sesión tras /clear. Palabras clave: planificación de tareas, planificación de proyecto, crear plan de trabajo, analizar tareas, organizar proyecto, seguimiento de progreso, planificación multipaso, ayúdame a planificar, desglosar proyecto

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂任务拆解成有序计划并持续跟踪进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 经常需要处理复杂多步任务,希望有条理地记录每一步进展
copy.tagline_en: Break complex tasks into trackable plans and follow progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle complex multi-step tasks and want to record progress clearly

howto.what: Claude 会在项目里维护三个文件（task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md），分别记计划、发现和进度；动手前先读，操作后更新，把计划内容当数据而非指令，会话中断后自动恢复。
howto.when: 当你提出做计划、拆解/组织多步骤项目、调研类任务，或任务需要超过 5 次工具调用时触发；若项目里已有计划文件，之后每次对话都会自动带上计划与进度上下文。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目拆成阶段计划，写进 task_plan.md
say.note: 它会建计划文件并按阶段推进。

say.text: 调研过程中每个新发现都追加到 findings.md
say.note: 发现会逐个写入该文件。

say.text: 按 progress.md 告诉我当前进度到哪了
say.note: 先读取进度文件再回答。

howto.what_en: Claude keeps task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project, recording plan, findings and progress. It reads them before acting, updates them after, treats plan content as data, and auto-resumes after a session break.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for planning, breaking down multi-step projects, research tasks, or work needing more than 5 tool calls. If plan files exist, it loads plan context on each prompt and restores the session after /clear.

say_en.text: Break this task into phases and save them in task_plan.md
say_en.note: It creates the plan file and tracks phases.

say_en.text: Append every new finding to findings.md during research
say_en.note: Each finding is written into that file.

say_en.text: Read progress.md and tell me our current status
say_en.note: It reads the progress file before answering.
